text:
SUPERVISOR DISPATCH — mesh smoothing + the sculpt data door. Marker: MESHSMOOTH-0606, ledger req_0024.

USER, verbatim: "im wondering if we can either try and make a tool to smooth out my own changes to something since claude clearly can round the mesh properly but cant shape it. i shaped it but its very low poly effect which i think if we get the matrix data we can use it to edit by hand and get a few samples?"

The division of labor the user is describing: THEY shape (the intent), the MACHINE rounds (the math). Two deliverables:

1. SMOOTH — a relax/smooth verb in the sculpt toolset (the GRABSHAPE lineage you built: draft.grids[part], regions.ts, one sculpt truth with the depth-paint): neighborhood relaxation over the deformation grid that kills the faceted low-poly look of hand pulls while preserving the shape's silhouette. Both application modes: a smooth BRUSH (local, paintable) and a smooth-part/smooth-selection ACTION (one press evens the whole thing). Strength/radius/iterations = P2 tunables. Works identically from the grid-paint and grab surfaces (one truth — a smooth is just another grid edit on the same chain, undoable, session-noted).
2. THE MATRIX DATA DOOR — expose the per-part deformation grid as data the user (and AI lanes) can edit directly: export the current grid to a readable file form + import it back (round-trip exact), and NAMED SAMPLES — save a shaped grid as a named snapshot, list/apply them (the user wants "a few samples" of good shapes to study and reuse). V20: samples/exports are additive storage, the grid format documented in the CAPTURE so a Claude lane can be handed a grid file and asked to round it numerically.
3. HONEST FINDING FIRST: before building, check whether the low-poly effect is partly grid RESOLUTION (the deformation grid's cell density vs the mesh) — if faceting is resolution-bound, smoothing alone polishes a coarse grid; surface the finding + the resolution knob option in CAPTURE rather than papering over it.

Fences: sculpt domain only (figure grids/regions/sculpt tools + their UI in /characters + workbench stage) — do NOT touch the paint surface (another lane, user mid-test), editors/cutout (frozen), or the pelvis-split lane's files (pane 4 is in game/figure parts/shapes — coordinate: your work is grids/tools, theirs is part topology; if you must touch the same file, STOP and report). NO desktop capture (pending-selfshot for visuals). P4 tests: smooth conserves silhouette bounds, export/import round-trip byte-exact, sample apply = grid equality. Explicit paths, docs+_index, verify green, resolve req_0024. READY FOR USER TEST — the user smoothing their own shaped mesh and pulling a sample file is the PASS.
